translation: The full Minecraft experience lets you enjoy Creative mode, achievements and Multiplayer with your friends across Minecraft devices! Play with friends on console, PC and mobile to create, explore and survive together.

source_string: As a part of the full Minecraft experience, Servers offer some of the most creative ways to enjoy Minecraft! Play great mini-games, meet the Minecraft community and make new friends.
translation: As a part of the full Minecraft experience, Servers offer some of the most creative ways to enjoy Minecraft! Play great mini-games, meet the Minecraft community and make new friends.

source_string: The full game allows access to Minecraft Marketplace, our in-game store. Switch up your look with new skins, change your world, or explore incredible new maps from the best community creators!
translation: The full game allows access to Minecraft Marketplace, our in-game store. Switch up your look with new skins, change your world, or explore incredible new maps from the best community creators!

source_string: A beloved part of the full Minecraft experience: Creative mode! Access the entire inventory - the only limit to what you can build is your imagination! Fly around your world, make your dream home out of anything and everything, or just blow up a mountain with unlimited TNT!
translation: A beloved part of the full Minecraft experience: Creative mode! Access the entire inventory - the only limit to what you can build is your imagination! Fly around your world, make your dream home out of anything and everything, or just blow up a mountain with unlimited TNT!

source_string: Want to make wolves act like bunnies? Turn all the trees into cotton candy? You can alter everything in the full Minecraft experience with add-ons! Plus get access to Multiplayer, Creative mode, achievements and more!
translation: Want to make wolves act like bunnies? Turn all the trees into cotton candy? You can alter everything in the full Minecraft experience with add-ons! Plus get access to Multiplayer, Creative mode, achievements and more!

source_string: The full Minecraft experience unlocks access to Seeds! Seeds help you discover new biomes - survive on ice plains, ascend extreme hills, or trek across deserts. Start with unique templates or explore random new worlds!
translation: The full Minecraft experience unlocks access to Seeds! Seeds help you discover new biomes - survive on ice plains, ascend extreme hills, or trek across deserts. Start with unique templates or explore random new worlds!

source_string: Get Minecraft, 700 Minecoins, 2 skin packs, 1 texture pack and 1 mash-up
translation: Dapatkan 700 Minecoin, 2 pek skin, 1 pek tekstur dan 1 mash-up

source_string: Get Minecraft, 1000 Minecoins, 4 skin packs, 2 texture packs, 3 maps, and 1 mash-up
translation: Get Minecraft, 1,000 Minecoins, 4 skin packs, 2 texture packs, 3 maps and 1 mash-up

source_string: Buy skins, textures and worlds in the Marketplace!
translation: Beli kekulit, tekstur dan dunia di Marketplace!

source_string: Buy skins, textures and worlds in the Marketplace!
translation: Beli kekulit, tekstur dan dunia di Marketplace!

source_string: Go on safari in a rugged off-road vehicle that seats 4!
translation: Go on safari in a rugged off-road vehicle that seats 4!

source_string: Explore Noxcrew's magical world full of ancient castles!
translation: Explore Noxcrew's magical world full of ancient castles!

source_string: Transform your Minecraft world into a comic!
translation: Ubah dunia Minecraft anda menjadi komik!

source_string: Vast tropical wilderness on a whirlwind hunt for treasure!
translation: Belantara tropika yang luas dengan pemburuan harta karun yang mendebarkan!

source_string: Explore an ancient world, texture pack and skins!
translation: Terokai dunia, pek tekstur dan kekulit purba!

source_string: Playgrounds filled with games and challenges!
translation: Taman permainan yang penuh dengan permainan dan cabaran!

source_string: Get ready for an explosion of rainbow pastel happiness!
translation: Get ready for an explosion of rainbow pastel happiness!

source_string: Make your worlds simple, colorful and vibrant!
translation: Make your worlds simple, colourful and vibrant!

source_string: Customize your character with this selection of skins!
translation: Customise your character with this selection of skins!

source_string: Dress as a Cake Maniac, Frankencrafter, or Worse!
translation: Dress as a Cake Maniac, Frankencrafter or Worse!

source_string: The original Minecraft experience: collect resources to craft tools and build structures, find and farm food to manage your hunger, battle dangerous mobs, and explore a vast world.
translation: The original Minecraft experience: collect resources to craft tools and build structures, find and farm food to manage your hunger, battle dangerous mobs and explore a vast world.

source_string: Start by collecting some wood and dirt for a makeshift home to help you survive the first night! From there it's all up to you.
translation: Mulakan dengan mengumpul kayu dan tanah untuk membina rumah sementara untuk membantu anda bertahan pada malam pertama! Dari situ semuanya terpulang kepada anda.

source_string: Build anything you can imagine in Creative Mode. Take no damage, fly through the skies, and enjoy instant access to every block in the game! This mode lets you focus on crafting and gives you everything you need to build something beautiful!
translation: Build anything you can imagine in Creative Mode. Take no damage, fly through the skies and enjoy instant access to every block in the game! This mode lets you focus on crafting and gives you everything you need to build something beautiful!

source_string: You'll also have access to Inspiration Island, a tutorial world and introduction to Creative mode that'll teach you how to be a master builder in no time! You can find more great worlds like this in Minecraft Marketplace.
translation: Anda juga akan mendapat akses ke Pulau Inspirasi, dunia tutorial dan pengenalan kepada mod Kreatif yang akan mengajar anda cara menjadi pembina mahir dalam masa yang singkat! Anda boleh menemui lebih banyak dunia hebat seperti ini di Minecraft Marketplace.

source_string: Adding an external server requires knowing the server name and server IP address. Once added, the server can be found in the server list for play.
translation: Menambah pelayan luaran memerlukan nama dan alamat IP pelayan. Setelah ditambah, pelayan tersebut boleh dimainkan di senarai pelayan.

source_string: This server has already been added

Feedback: Why didn't you sign in?
translation: Maklum Balas: Kenapa anda tidak daftar masuk?

source_string: You can hold down Shift to take a close up picture using the Camera.
translation: Anda boleh menahan Shift untuk mengambil gambar dekat menggunakan Kamera.

source_string: Unlike Signs, you can edit Slates, Posters, and Boards over and over again.
translation: Unlike Signs, you can edit Slates, Posters, and Boards over and over again.

source_string: Use Ctrl+B to turn on text-to-speech capabilities for in-game chat.
translation: Gunakan Ctrl+B untuk menghidupkan pilihan teks kepada ucapan untuk ruang perbualan dalam permainan.

source_string: You can export your Minecraft world to share it with others.
translation: Anda boleh mengeksport dunia Minecraft anda untuk berkongsi dengan orang lain.

source_string: To have your peers connect to your world, pause your game and share your join code.
translation: Untuk membolehkan rakan sebaya anda berhubung dengan dunia anda, jeda permainan anda dan kongsi kod penyertaan anda.

source_string: Remember that to use slash commands, you need to enable cheats in your world.
translation: Perlu ingat, untuk menggunakan perintah-perintah tanda garis miring atau slash, anda perlu benarkan elat dalam dunia anda.

source_string: Done with your creation? Have others tour your world as visitors to protect your work.
translation: Selesai dengan ciptaan anda? Jadikan orang yang mengunjungi dunia anda sebagai pelawat untuk melindungi hasil kerja anda.

source_string: To code in Minecraft, press "C" on your keyboard or touch the Agent icon at the top of your screen.
translation: Untuk mengekod dalam Minecraft, tekan "C" pada papan kekunci anda atau sentuh ikon Agent di bahagian atas skrin anda.

source_string: Use the Library to find new game worlds to build in.
translation: Gunakan Pustaka untuk mencari dunia permainan baharu untuk dibina.

source_string: Looking for a specific biome? Try the Library.
translation: Mencari biom tertentu? Cuba lihat Pustaka.

source_string: In Survival Mode, players must find their own resources.
translation: Dalam Mod Bertahan Hidup, pemain harus mencari sumber sendiri.

source_string: In Creative Mode, players can freely choose to build from any of the blocks in Minecraft.
translation: Dalam Mod Kreatif, pemain boleh pilih dengan bebasnya untuk membina dengan sebarang blok di dalam Minecraft.

source_string: Your code building robot helper is called the Agent.
translation: Robot pembantu pembinaan kod anda dipanggil Agent.

source_string: Redstone can be used in Minecraft to create circuits and simple machines.
translation: Redstone boleh digunakan dalam Minecraft untuk mencipta litar dan mesin ringkas.

source_string: You can copy and paste from a text editor to a slate, poster, board, or into chat.
translation: You can copy and paste from a text editor to a slate, poster, board or into chat.

source_string: Show hints for commonly-used keyboard and mouse controls by pressing "H" on your keyboard.
translation: Tunjukkan petunjuk untuk kawalan papan kekunci dan tetikus yang biasa digunakan dengan menekan "H" pada papan kekunci anda.

source_string: You can toggle Auto Jump on or off in the Settings menu under Controls.
translation: Anda boleh menogol Auto Lompat dalam menu Tetapan di bawah Kawalan.

source_string: While in Creative Mode, quickly press jump twice to fly.
translation: Semasa dalam Mod Kreatif, tekan lompat dua kali dengan cepat untuk terbang.

source_string: Choose a Default Game Mode when creating a world to specify the type of gameplay you want.
translation: Pilih Mod Permainan Lalai apabila mencipta dunia untuk menentukan jenis permainan yang anda mahukan.

source_string: Use the command "/setworldspawn" to have new players begin playing where you are standing.
translation: Use the command '/setworldspawn' to have new players begin playing where you are standing.

source_string: Choose a default player permission when creating your world to specify the permissions you want your classmates to have when they join.
translation: Pilih keizinan pemain lalai semasa mencipta dunia anda untuk menentukan keizinan yang anda mahu rakan sekelas anda miliki apabila mereka menyertai.

source_string: Press "I" on your keyboard or touch the Immersive Reader icon to read or translate in-game text.
translation: Tekan "I" pada papan kekunci anda atau sentuh ikon Pembaca Imersif untuk membaca atau menterjemah teks dalam permainan.

source_string: To add or change an NPC in your world, first make yourself a world builder with "/wb".
translation: Untuk menambah atau menukar NPC dalam dunia anda, mula-mula jadikan diri anda pembina dunia dengan "/wb".

source_string: There's a brand new build challenge every month! Find them all in the Library under Monthly Build Challenges.
translation: Terdapat cabaran binaan serba baharu setiap bulan! Cari kesemuanya di Perpustakaan di bawah Cabaran Binaan Bulanan.

source_string: Find related lessons by clicking on tags in the Library.
translation: Cari pelajaran berkaitan dengan mengklik pada tag dalam Pustaka.

source_string: Game moving slowly? Try turning down the render distance in Settings.
translation: Permainan berjalan dengan perlahan? Cuba rendahkan jarak pengemukaan di Tetapan.

source_string: Want to use Code Builder? Make sure cheats are toggled on.
translation: Ingin menggunakan Pembina Kod? Pastikan elat telah dihidupkan.

source_string: Press F5 to change player perspective.
translation: Tekan F5 untuk mengubah perspektif permainan.

source_string: Use "/spawnpoint" to change your spawn point. It's just like you slept in a bed!
translation: Gunakan "/spawnpoint" untuk menukar titik penjelmaan anda. Ia sama seperti anda tidur di atas katil!

source_string: Most monsters only come out at night. During the day you're safe... probably.
translation: Kebanyakan raksasa hanya keluar pada waktu malam. Pada siang hari anda selamat... mungkin.

source_string: Break blocks, pick up resources. Use the crafting grid to make helpful items. Now you're crafting!
translation: Pecahkan blok, ambil sumber. Gunakan grid pertukangan untuk membuat item yang berguna. Sekarang anda sedang bertukang!

source_string: You have endless lives, but your items drop to the ground when you die. Hurry back to pick them up!
translation: Anda mempunyai kehidupan yang tidak berkesudahan, tetapi barang-barang anda jatuh ke tanah apabila anda mati. Cepat kembali untuk mengambilnya!

source_string: It's a good idea to build a place where you can safely spend the night.
translation: Ianya idea yang bagus untuk membina tempat untuk meluangkan waktu malam dengan selamat.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Chopping wood with an axe is much faster than using your hands.
translation: Gunakan alat yang betul untuk tugas yang betul! Memotong kayu dengan kapak lebih pantas daripada dengan tangan.

source_string: Even in Minecraft you'll get hungry, so try to find something to eat before that happens.
translation: Dalam Minecraft juga anda akan lapar; jadi cuba cari sesuatu untuk dimakan sebelum hal itu terjadi.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.
translation: Menggali lurus ke bawah atau ke atas bukanlah idea yang bagus.

source_string: Monsters spawn in the dark. Craft a torch to brighten up any space.
translation: Raksasa menjelma dalam gelap. Buat obor untuk mencerahkan mana-mana ruang.

source_string: Beds are great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set your respawn point.
translation: Katil itu bagus! Tukangkannya untuk melepasi waktu malam dengan cepat dan menetapkan titik penjelmaan anda.

source_string: Be careful when you swim. Stay under water for too long and you'll run out of air.
translation: Awas ketika berenang. Kalau terlalu lama berada dalam air, anda akan kehabisan udara.

source_string: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!
translation: Mod kemandirian mempunyai 4 tahap kesukaran yang berbeza - Aman, Senang, Biasa dan Sukar. Atau mainkan mod Kreatif dan dapatkan sumber yang tidak berkesudahan!

source_string: The world of Minecraft is endlessly surprising. You'll find lots of different animals, plants, and even §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r
translation: Dunia Minecraft ini sangat mengejutkan. Anda akan menjumpai banyak haiwan, tumbuhan, dan juga §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Berikan tulang kepada serigala untuk menjinakkannya. Lalu anda boleh menyuruhnya duduk atau mengikuti anda.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Wearing a Carved Pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Tuai kulit daripada lembu, dan gunakannya untuk membuat zirah dan buku.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Anda boleh mengisi baldi dengan air, lahar, susu, salji serbuk... dan segelintir makhluk.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Memberi makan haiwan akan menghalangnya daripada menyahjelma. Bina sebuah kandang untuk menjaganya.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: Membina gerbang membolehkan anda berkunjung ke dimensi lain yang dipanggil Nether.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Serbuk tulang (dihasilkan daripada tulang kerangka) boleh digunakan sebagai baja yang boleh membuat sesuatu tumbuh serta-merta!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian tercipta apabila air mengenai blok sumber lahar.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Jika blok sumber bagi air atau lahar dihilangkan, alirannya akan berhenti sepenuhnya.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Berhati-hati apabila membina struktur yang diperbuat daripada bulu di kawasan terbuka, kerana kilat daripada ribut petir boleh membakar bulu.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Satu baldi lahar boleh digunakan di dalam relau untuk meleburkan 100 blok.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: Alat muzik yang dimainkan oleh blok not bergantung kepada bahan yang terletak di bawahnya.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: Serigala dan golem besi tidak akan menyerang creeper.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidian boleh dilombong menggunakan beliung berlian.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creeper adalah sumber serbuk letupan yang paling mudah diperolehi.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Serigala jinak menunjukkan nyawa mereka dengan kedudukan ekor mereka. Beri mereka daging untuk menyembuhkan mereka.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Pewarna yang berbeza boleh dibuat daripada pelbagai bahan, masak kaktus dalam relau untuk mendapatkan pewarna hijau!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: Khinzir yang disambar petir akan berubah menjadi piglin terzombi.

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Kadang-kadang golem besi memberi bunga kepada anak-anak kampung!
Harimau Oselot menunjukkan creeper siapa yang lebih kuat!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Gunakan rumput laut untuk mengumpan dan membiakkan penyu.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
translation: Lindungi anak penyu daripada makhluk jahat!

source_string: Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: Anak penyu akan melepaskan skutnya apabila tumbuh dewasa - ini boleh dibuat menjadi karapas penyu.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
translation: Bru beberapa posyen pernafasan air untuk penjelajahan bawah air!

source_string: Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: Dolfin boleh membawa anda ke karam kapal dan peninggalan lautan, Beri mereka ikan kod dan ikuti jejak mereka!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Jeruk laut boleh dilebur menjadi pewarna hijau muda.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Gunakan bandela jerami untuk membiakkan Llama!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: Kompas sentiasa mengarah ke titik penjelmaan dunia - buat sebuah kompas dan cari jalannya!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Berdagang dengan orang kampung untuk mendapatkan makanan, peralatan, dan juga peta peneroka!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Tahukah anda bahawa anda boleh memegang peta dengan tangan kedua anda?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Tali pengikat boleh digunakan pada sampan.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Selinap untuk berjalan di atas blok magma dengan selamat.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
translation: Anda boleh mengumpul sarang labah-labah dengan menggunakan pemotong.

source_string: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: Trisula boleh dilepaskan oleh Si Lemas, dan boleh dipegang atau dibaling.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: Anda boleh meleburkan 20 item di dalam relau dengan menggunakan blok kelp kering sebagai bahan api.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: Menjinakkan kuda kerangka tidak memerlukan pelana.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: Khayalan ialah makhluk berbahaya yang muncul pada waktu malam. Pastikan anda tidur dengan kerap!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Zombi bertukar menjadi Si Lemas jika ia tenggelam di dalam air.
Berlari di dalam air untuk berenang!
Jangan kau bunuh dolfin, tak berperikemanusiaan!

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Apabila menggali lurus ke atas, letakkan obor di kaki anda untuk memecahkan pasir atau kerikil yang berpotensi jatuh menimpa anda.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Gunakan Pemotong pada Sarang Lebah semula jadi atau Buatan untuk mendapatkan Indung Madu, gunakan Botol untuk mendapatkan madunya.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Letakkan unggun api di bawah sarang lebah semula jadi atau buatan untuk menuai madu.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: Bijih zamrud ialah bijih yang paling jarang muncul di Minecraft! Ia hanya boleh ditemukan di pergunungan dan padang rumput.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Perlukan berlian? Mereka akan lebih banyak muncul apabila anda pergi lebih dalam.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Katak suka makan makhluk kecil dan berbentuk blok.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: Pepari suka mendapatkan item! Jika anda memberinya item tertentu, ia akan cuba mendapatkan lebih banyak lagi item tersebut.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Katak memilih varian berdasarkan suhu biom tempat berudu membesar.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
translation: Anda boleh mengumpul berudu dalam baldi.

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Bandar purba boleh ditemui di bawah banjaran gunung.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: Pepari sukakan muzik yang bermaksud mereka berinteraksi dengan blok not!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Gunakan botol air pada blok tanah untuk mendapatkan lumpur!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: Apabila mengembara ke dalam kegelamatan dalam, kesunyian adalah kunci.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Segelintir binatang akan mengikuti anda jika anda memegang gandum.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Sebelum anda melombong berlian, redstone, atau emas, pastikan anda sedang menggunakan beliung besi atau berlian. Kalau tidak, bijihnya tidak akan keluar.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Meletakkan dua peti bersebelahan akan menghasilkan satu peti besar.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: Tak dapat jumpa arang batu untuk membuat obor? Cuba leburkan kayu balak di dalam relau.
Keajaiban tak terbatas, kemungkinan tak berpenghujung.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Tanam anak pokok dan ia akan membesar menjadi pokok.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Gunakan cangkul untuk menyediakan kawasan tanah untuk penanaman.

source_string: Zombified piglins won't attack you - unless you make them angry.
translation: Piglin Terzombi tidak akan menyerang anda, melainkan anda menyerang mereka.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Kembalikan bebola api itu kepada Ghast sang penghantar!

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Batu buntar tahan letupan bebola api Ghast, menjadikannya berguna untuk menjaga gerbang.

source_string: Our music is by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.
translation: Our music is by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Nanti-nanti adalah kemas kini untuk permainan ini!

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: Versi pertama Minecraft dicipta dalam hanya 6 hari!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: Bahasa Enderman sebenarnya ialah bahasa Inggeris secara terbalik.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: Nama asal untuk Minecraft adalah Cave Game.

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: Joki Labah-labah ialah kemunculan jarang labah-labah yang ditunggangi oleh kerangka!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the Overworld.
translation: Mengembara satu blok di dalam Nether adalah sama dengan mengembara lapan blok di Permukaan.

source_string: Use phantom membranes to repair your elytra.
translation: Gunakan membran khayalan untuk membaiki elitra anda.

source_string: Elytra can be used to glide, find them in End city ships!
translation: Elitra boleh digunakan untuk terbang, cari Elitra di dalam kapal Bandar End!

source_string: Test out some new features by turning on Experimental Gameplay in the settings menu!
translation: Cuba uji beberapa ciri yang baharu dengan menghidupkan Tatamain Uji Kaji di menu tetapan!

source_string: Monsters that are killed by skeletons arrows have a chance of dropping music discs.
translation: Creeper yang dibunuh oleh anak panah kerangka ada kemungkinan untuk menjatuhkan cakera muzik.

source_string: Texture packs change the way that blocks, items, and even the menus look in game. Try them out!
translation: Pek tekstur mengubah rupa blok, item dan juga menu dalam permainan. Cubalah!

source_string: Using firework rockets boosts elytra speed in mid air. Just... make sure they don't explode, otherwise it'll hurt BADLY!
translation: Menggunakan roket bunga api menaikkan kelajuan elitra di udara. Cuma ingat... pastikan ia tidak meletup, jika tidak anda akan tercedera dengan TERUK!
Adakah orang memang baca benda ini?

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: Penyihiran Arusan akan mendorong anda menerusi udara yang berhujan.

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a Nether star from the Wither!
translation: Suar ialah item berkuasa yang hanya dapat ditukangkan dengan bintang Nether yang didapatkan daripada Wither!

source_string: Nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions.
translation: Bintang Nether tidak boleh dihancurkan oleh letupan.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged respawn anchor.
translation: Menjelma semula di dalam Nether memerlukan penambat penjelmaan yang dicas.

source_string: You can charge a respawn anchor with glowstone.
translation: Anda boleh mengecas penambat penjelmaan menggunakan batu menyala.

source_string: You can breed hoglins with crimson fungus, but be careful.
translation: Anda boleh membiakkan hoglin dengan kulat merah, tetapi berhati-hati.

source_string: Gold is most common in the Nether and in the badlands biome.
translation: Emas paling banyak ditemui di dalam Nether dan biom Tanah Tandus.

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Diorit, anda hanya boleh menyukainya atau membencinya.

source_string: Take a screenshot using the Game menu.
translation: Ambil tangkapan layar dengan menggunakan Menu permainan.

source_string: A Realm is always online, so you and your friends can play here whenever you want.
translation: Sebuah Realm itu sentiasa berada dalam talian, jadi anda dan rakan anda boleh bermain di sini pada bila-bila masa yang anda mahukan.

source_string: Keep up to date with what's going on in your Realm by checking the Story Feed in Realms Stories.
translation: Ikuti perkembangan terkini dengan perkara yang berlaku di Realm anda dengan menyemak Suapan Cerita dalam Cerita Realm.

source_string: Share your great moments with the other players on this Realm by adding a story to the Story Feed.
translation: Kongsi detik hebat anda dengan pemain lain di Realm ini dengan menambahkan cerita pada Suapan Cerita.

source_string: Check the Timeline in Realms Stories to find out when others are playing.
translation: Semak Garis Masa dalam Cerita Realm untuk mengetahui apabila orang lain bermain.

source_string: Access Realms Stories from the game menu while playing on the Realm.
translation: Akses Cerita Realm daripada menu permainan semasa bermain di dalam Realm.

source_string: Get to know your Realm's community on the Members tab in Realms Stories.
translation: Kenali komuniti Realm anda pada tab Ahli dalam Cerita Realm.

source_string: Use Realms Stories to get social, keep up with your friends' progress, and organize playtime.
translation: Gunakan Cerita Realm untuk bersosial, mengikuti perkembangan rakan anda dan mengatur masa bermain.

source_string: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
translation: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
context: A fun way to tell players that they can fly if they press the jump button twice.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
translation: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
context: Players can use an item called Sawn Egg to summon animals and monsters.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
translation: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
context: Goat horn is an object players can use to play loud sounds.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
translation: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
context: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs. TNT will explode when you light it.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
translation: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
context: To  encourage players to build railroads{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
translation: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
translation: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
translation: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
translation: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
context: There is a feature called “Pick block” that enables players to instantly equip any block they click on. If you click on a mob(animal or monster) you will get a spawn egg that summons another monster/animal of that kind.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
translation: Get there now with the /tp command.
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other...
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation: A warden a day keeps the... well, everything away.
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
translation: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
translation: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
translation: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
context: Phantoms are flying mobs(monsters) that spawn when you havn't slept for a few days. They won't hurt you in Creative Mode. To get rid of them you sleep in a bed.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...
translation: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...
context: Lava doesn't hurt you in creative mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A second player can't join right now.
translation: Pemain kedua tidak boleh sertai sekarang.

source_string: You have too many controllers connected while in Local Network Mode to join this game.
translation: Terlalu banyak alat kawalan tersambung semasa di mod Rangkaian Tempatan untuk menyertai permainan ini.

source_string: Some worlds are not available because they could not be moved. Restart Minecraft to try again.
translation: Some worlds are not available because they could not be moved. Restart Minecraft to try again.

source_string: Read the FAQ for more info.
translation: Read the FAQ for more info.

source_string: You don't have enough free space to move your files to a new location.
translation: You don't have enough free space to copy your files to a new location.

source_string: We need to move your files to a different location on your device.
translation: We need to copy your files to a different location on your device.

source_string: We're in the middle of moving your data to a new location on your device. Please press resume to finish the move.
translation: Kami sedang mengalihkan data anda ke lokasi baharu pada peranti anda. Sila tekan teruskan untuk menyelesaikan langkah tersebut.

source_string: We're in the middle of moving your data to a new location on your device, but you don't have enough free space.
translation: We're in the middle of copying your data to a new location on your device, but you don't have enough free space.

source_string: Please free up at least %s to continue.
translation: Please free up at least %s to continue.

source_string: Your files have been moved successfully. Please restart Minecraft.
translation: Fail anda telah berjaya dipindahkan. Sila mulakan semula Minecraft.

source_string: We couldn't move all your files. We encountered the following error: (%s).
translation: We couldn't copy all your files. We encountered the following error: (%s).

source_string: Failed (file I/O error or no space left)
translation: Failed (file I/O error or no space left)

source_string: Select "Delete Now" to delete all previous log files.
translation: Pilih "Padam Sekarang" untuk padam semua fail log terdahulu.

source_string: Note: The log file for your currently active session will remain.
translation: Perhatian: Fail log untuk sesi yang aktif semasa anda akan kekal.

source_string: Based on your recent support ticket, Mojang Player Support has granted permission to upload your world. You can upload your affected world from the World Select screen or under World Settings.
translation: Berdasarkan tiket bantuan anda baru-baru ini, pihak Bantuan Pemain Mojang telah memberi anda keizinan untuk memuat naik dunia anda. Anda boleh memuat naik dunia anda yang terjejas daripada skrin Pilih Dunia atau di bawah Tetapan Dunia.

source_string: Do not show this screen again

To upload your world, accept the Microsoft Services Agreement. Uploaded worlds are subject to the Microsoft Services Agreement, which can be found under Terms of Use. You can still play with your world once uploaded.
translation: Untuk memuat naik dunia anda, terima Perjanjian Perkhidmatan Microsoft. Dunia yang dimuat naik tertakluk kepada Perjanjian Perkhidmatan Microsoft, yang boleh didapati di bawah Syarat Penggunaan. Anda masih boleh bermain di dalam dunia anda setelah dimuat naik.

source_string: Uploading your world files may take a few minutes. Do not turn off the game or leave this screen during the upload process.

source_string: Realms are small personal servers to host your Minecraft world. Unlike a regular multiplayer session, Realms are always online, so you don’t have to be there for your friends to play. Unlike a large public Minecraft server, Realms are by invite only, so you control who gets in.
translation: Realms ialah pelayan peribadi kecil untuk mengehoskan dunia Minecraft anda. Tidak seperti sesi multipemain biasa, Realms sentiasa berada dalam talian, jadi anda tidak perlu berada di sana untuk rakan anda bermain. Tidak seperti pelayan Minecraft awam yang besar, penyertaan Realms adalah melalui jemputan sahaja, jadi anda boleh mengawal siapa yang dapat masuk.

source_string: Realms Plus subscriptions include Marketplace Pass: free Marketplace content, updated monthly. With skins, Character Creator items, worlds, and more, there's always something new for you to try.

Akses kepada Kandungan Premium yang Dikurasi

source_string: Share your adventures on the Story Feed, watch your Realm grow with the Members tab, know when people have been playing on the Realm with the Timeline.

source_string: No need for technical know-how. Free, no-hassle backups. No sharing personal information.
translation: No need for technical know-how. Free, no-hassle backups. No sharing personal information.

source_string: People you invite become Realm members. They don’t need to pay to join and play on the Realm; they just need a copy of Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.
translation: Orang yang anda jemput akan menjadi ahli Realm. Mereka tidak perlu membayar untuk menyertai dan bermain di Realm; mereka hanya memerlukan salinan Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.

source_string: Worlds uploaded to your Realm are always available to you and your invited Realm members – at any time, on any device. Members can play even when you’re away.

source_string: Run your own Minecraft server! You set the rules: who can join and how to play. Members play for free, even when you’re offline. Easy to set up, manage, and access from any device.
translation: Jalankan pelayan Minecraft anda sendiri! Anda yang menetapkan peraturan: siapa yang boleh menyertai dan cara bermain. Ahli bermain secara percuma, walaupun anda berada di luar talian. Mudah untuk disediakan, diurus dan diakses daripada mana-mana peranti.
Pelayan anda sendiri, sentiasa dalam talian

source_string: - There are two modes within the Editor: Tool or Crosshair. Tool is focused on using the multi-block editing tools as available via the UI and free-moving cursor, and Crosshair is for more precise, single-block edits using a crosshair in 1st person.
translation: - There are two modes within the Editor: Tool or Crosshair. Tool is focused on using the multi-block editing tools as available via the UI and free-moving cursor, and Crosshair is for more precise, single-block edits using a crosshair in 1st person.

source_string: - UI orientation: The left array of tools is referred to as the "toolrail", the top array is the "action bar" (eg. undo/redo), and the very top is the "menu" (eg. File).
translation: - UI orientation: The left array of tools is referred to as the "toolrail", the top array is the "action bar" (eg. undo/redo), and the very top is the "menu" (eg. File).

source_string: - For most UI actions and tools, there is a corresponding hotkey and sometimes a slash cmd.
translation: - For most UI actions and tools, there is a corresponding hotkey and sometimes a slash cmd.

source_string: - Rotate camera / unlock movement: In Tool, hold down right mouse button. In Crosshair, you do not need to hold down the right mouse button.
translation: - Rotate camera / unlock movement: In Tool, hold down right mouse button. In Crosshair, you do not need to hold down the right mouse button.

source_string: - Move on the XZ axis: WASD
translation: - Move on the XZ axis: WASD

source_string: - Move on the Y axis: E (up), Q (down)
translation: - Move on the Y axis: SPACE (up), SHIFT (down)

source_string: - Toggle between Tool and Crosshair Modes: (CTRL+TAB) or the UI button at the bottom of the viewport. When in Crosshair, you will need to use the hotkeys, though -- (CTRL+TAB) or ESC.
translation: - Toggle between Tool and Crosshair Modes: (CTRL+TAB) or the UI button at the bottom of the viewport. When in Crosshair, you will need to use the hotkeys, though -- (CTRL+TAB) or ESC.

source_string: View the detailed directory of controls:
translation: View the detailed directory of controls:

source_string: Actions are shortcuts that live at the top of your screen. Hit the “+” button in the Action Bar to customize which are displayed.
translation: Actions are shortcuts that live at the top of your screen. Hit the “+” button in the Action Bar to customize which are displayed.

source_string: At the top center of your screen is the Hotbar. Click once to change the active block, click twice to open the Block Picker to customize the Hotbar.
translation: At the top center of your screen is the Block Hotbar. Click once to change the active block, click twice to open the Block Picker to customize the Hotbar.

source_string: You can create a new Hotbar by clicking the Hotbar Menu button to the right.
translation: You can create a new Hotbar by clicking the Hotbar Menu button to the right.

source_string: To navigate in the Editor, you’ll need a keyboard and mouse. Trackpads or controllers aren’t recommended.
translation: To navigate in the Editor, you’ll need a keyboard and mouse. Trackpads or controllers aren’t recommended.

source_string: Hold down the right mouse button to look around.
translation: Hold down the right mouse button to look around.

source_string: Use WASD to move horizontally and Q & E to move vertically.
translation: While holding the right mouse button, move horizontally with WASD and vertically with SHIFT and SPACE.

source_string: You can find tools on the left rail. Each tool allows you to edit your world in different ways.
translation: You can find tools on the left rail. Each tool allows you to edit your world in different ways.

source_string: Click on the Information button ("i") at the top right corner of each tool to learn more about how it works.
translation: Click on the Information button ("i") at the top right corner of each tool to learn more about how it works.

source_string: Minecraft is a game about placing blocks to build anything you can imagine. At night monsters come out, so make sure to build a shelter before that happens.
translation: Minecraft adalah permainan tentang meletakkan blok untuk membina apa saja yang anda boleh bayangkan. Pada waktu malam raksasa akan keluar, jadi pastikan anda membina tempat perlindungan sebelum itu berlaku.

source_string: Use the mouse to look around.
Touch and drag along the screen to look around.
translation: Sentuh dan seret sepanjang skrin untuk melihat sekeliling.

source_string: Press :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession or press :_input_key.sprint: to sprint. While you hold :_input_key.forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Tekan :_input_key.forward: dua kali secara pantas atau tekan :_input_key.sprint: untuk pecut. Semasa anda menahan :_input_key.forward:, anda akan terus pecut sehingga anda mempunyai kurang daripada :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :_gamepad_stick_left: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Tolak :_gamepad_stick_left: ke hadapan dua kali secara pantas untuk pecut. Semasa anda menahan :_gamepad_stick_left: ke hadapan, anda akan terus pecut sehingga anda mempunyai kurang daripada :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Press :touch_forward: twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :touch_forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Tekan :touch_forward: dua kali secara pantas untuk pecut. Semasa anda menahan :touch_forward:, anda akan terus pecut sehingga anda mempunyai kurang daripada :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :rift_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :rift_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Tolak :rift_left_stick: ke hadapan dua kali secara pantas untuk pecut. Semasa anda menahan :rift_left_stick: ke hadapan, anda akan terus pecut sehingga anda mempunyai kurang daripada :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :windowsmr_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :windowsmr_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Tolak :windowsmr_left_stick: ke hadapan dua kali secara pantas untuk pecut. Semasa anda menahan :windowsmr_left_stick: ke hadapan, anda akan terus pecut sehingga anda mempunyai kurang daripada :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Hold :_input_key.attack: to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Tahan :_input_key.attack: untuk melombong dan menetak menggunakan tangan anda atau apa saja yang anda pegang. Anda mungkin perlu membuat alat untuk melombong sesetengah blok.

source_string: Touch and hold the screen on a block to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Sentuh dan tahan skrin pada blok untuk melombong dan menetak menggunakan tangan anda atau apa saja yang anda pegang. Anda mungkin perlu membuat alat untuk melombong sesetengah blok.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.
translation: Jika anda memegang item di tangan anda, gunakan :_input_key.use: untuk menggunakan item itu atau tekan :_input_key.drop: untuk menjatuhkannya.

translation: Jika anda memegang item di tangan anda, sentuh skrin untuk menggunakan item itu atau sentuh dan tahan item dalam palang utama anda untuk menjatuhkannya.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To sneak, hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Menyelinap sangat berguna dalam Minecraft, menyelinap menghalang anda daripada terjatuh dari blok dan menyembunyikan label nama anda. Untuk menyelinap, tahan :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :_input_key.sneak: or click :_gamepad_stick_right:.
translation: Menyelinap sangat berguna dalam Minecraft, menyelinap menghalang anda daripada terjatuh dari blok dan menyembunyikan label nama anda. Untuk togol selinap, tekan :_input_key.sneak: atau klik :_gamepad_stick_right:.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the mouse to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Memecut semasa di dalam air akan membuatkan anda berenang. Gunakan tetikus untuk mengawal arah yang anda berenang.

translation: Memecut semasa di dalam air akan membuatkan anda berenang. Gunakan :_gamepad_stick_right: untuk mengawal arah yang anda berenang.
